title: Design System: Muhammad Sayyedain AI Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero statement and the drenched contact heading; Archivo at 118% width.

headline.purpose: Section and flagship project headings; Archivo at 115% width.

title.purpose: Project summaries, group titles, working-note statements.

body.purpose: Readable explanations in Source Sans 3, capped at 65ch.

label.purpose: Status pills, kickers, diagram chrome — Archivo 640, never below 0.68rem, never a mono costume.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Floating scene chips and ranked cards; never combined with a visible border.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The hero invoice sheet only — the single deepest elevation on the site.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.purpose: Hero choreography; transform-only, content never hidden.

motion.name: stamp-spring
motion.purpose: The REVIEW stamp settling — the one springy moment allowed.

motion.name: pointer-tilt
motion.purpose: 3D inspection tilt; disabled for touch and reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority action in a content group.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #AA3606; color: #FFFFFF; font: 650 0.98rem/1.2 "Source Sans 3", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #251C19; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #AA3606; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis action such as résumé download.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid #B9AEAA; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #251C19; font: 650 0.98rem/1.2 "Source Sans 3", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #251C19; background: #F7F3F0; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #AA3606; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Project status: a colored dot plus words, never color alone.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 13px; border: 1px solid #B9AEAA; border-radius: 999px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #251C19; font: 620 0.8rem/1.3 "Archivo", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-stretch: 104%; } .ds-status-pill i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #DD5316; }

components.name: Active Navigation Link
components.description: Header link with the amber active underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding-inline: 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: #413531; font: 600 0.92rem/1 "Source Sans 3", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #F7F3F0; color: #251C19; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #AA3606; } .ds-nav-link-active::after { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 6px; left: 12px; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: #DD5316; content: ""; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #AA3606; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Project Link
components.description: Inline route link underlined in the project accent.
components.css: .ds-project-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #251C19; font: 650 1rem/1.2 "Source Sans 3", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #DD5316; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-project-link:hover { color: #AA3606; } .ds-project-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #AA3606; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: A recruiter opens the portfolio at 11am between interviews and finds a sunlit examination workshop: white museum table, amber-glass instruments, precise soft shadows. The CACE examination metaphor runs through the site with the lights on — an invoice is read, checked against policy, and stamped for human review. Futurism is carried by CSS 3D depth, wide-stance Archivo type, and one choreographed entrance; never by dark-terminal costume, mono annotation fog, glow, or particles. Emphasis follows importance: the flagship system and the amber contact close are the loudest moments.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white canvas with porcelain panels and a warm ink ramp.
Amber as identity (flags, stamps, actions, the drenched close); petrol as the cool counterpoint (retrieval, evaluation, one deep panel).
Archivo Variable at expanded widths for voice; Source Sans 3 for explanation; no monospace anywhere.
Three deliberate project scales: flagship, split, compact — no identical mega-blocks.
Varied section openers; numbers only where order is information.
Honesty as a design system: status pills with words, evidence-boundary notes, no invented links or metrics.

rules.name: The White-Text-On-Fills Rule
rules.body: Any amber or petrol fill carries white text. Dark text on saturated fills is prohibited.

rules.name: The Amber Split Rule
rules.body: Bright amber (#DD5316) is for large display accents, dots, and flags only; amber-fill (#AA3606) is for anything carrying normal-size text.

rules.name: The One-Dark-Moment Rule
rules.body: Petrol-deep appears exactly twice: the training path panel and the PalPath X-ray stage. It is an environment, not a theme.

rules.name: The No-Costume Rule
rules.body: No monospace, no eyebrow labels above headings, no decorative numbering. Machine flavor comes from content, not typography.

rules.name: The Readability Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing below 0.68rem, and only diagram chrome may go below 0.74rem.

rules.name: The Shadow-Or-Border Rule
rules.body: Elevated pieces use a shadow with no border; flat panels use a border with no wide blur. Never both.

rules.name: The Never-Hidden Rule
rules.body: Entrance choreography animates transform only. No content is opacity-gated behind an animation.

dos: **Do** keep the CACE examination scene the single dominant hero effect, with plain-language chip labels a non-technical recruiter can read.
**Do** scale project presentation by importance: CACE flagship, Production RAG split, FLAN-T5 and PalPath compact.
**Do** keep every status pill, evidence boundary, and 'code not public yet' note visible and truthful.
**Do** use Archivo width (font-stretch 104–118%) as the voice axis; keep body copy in Source Sans 3 under 65ch.
**Do** verify contrast on every new pairing (body 16.7:1, muted 7.5:1, white on amber-fill 6.4:1).
**Do** preserve /resume.pdf, canonical GitHub/LinkedIn/email links, the PalPath repository and authentication preview, and reduced-motion fallbacks.
**Do** keep 44px targets, the skip link, focus trapping in the mobile menu, and role="img" labels on scenes.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce IBM Plex Mono, sub-0.68rem annotations, eyebrow labels, or decorative 01/02 numbering.
**Don't** add gradient text, glassmorphism, particles, glowing borders, orbiting decorations, brains, robots, sparkles, or rockets.
**Don't** invent repositories, metrics, benchmark bars, testimonials, clients, or production claims.
**Don't** put dark text on amber or petrol fills, pair a 1px border with a wide blurred shadow, or exceed 18px radius on ordinary panels.
**Don't** gate content visibility behind animations or hide the 'currently building CACE' signal on mobile.
**Don't** return to the dark graphite terminal-forensic look or a purple-blue neon AI template.
